artworks.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.5 × 6.7 cm (3 3/8 × 2 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ceremonial scene in front of a fortress. The image depicts a group of figures gathered in front of a large, fortified structure resembling a castle. Many figures are present, holding spears and flags, with some on horseback. The flags contain letters and are held high. The background shows stone walls, arched entrances, and towers, indicating a scene of historical or military significance. An arched gateway is a focal point, allowing movement within the fortress. The atmosphere conveys a sense of historical narrative or a grand event unfolding.

artworks.title: Raising of the Cross
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.9 × 5.3 cm (3 1/8 × 2 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a large group gathered around a crucifixion event. The drawing details a busy scene with a crowd of people observing or participating in the act of raising a figure on a cross upon a hill. In the foreground, figures on horseback and foot are seen, some of whom are holding long spears or staves, while others appear to be gesturing or looking towards the central activity. The central focus is on the figure on the cross being elevated with the help of ropes and ladders. In the background, more figures are visible, adding to the sense of a densely populated, possibly chaotic scene. The intricacy of the linework suggests a meticulous and detailed style, capturing both individual expressions and group dynamics.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.5 × 5.7 cm (2 15/16 × 2 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. There is a cross at the center bearing a figure, flanked by two other crosses with figures. Surrounding this central trio are gathered figures, including mounted riders, soldiers with spears, and onlookers. Above the central cross is a sign with "INRI," with clouds and rays adding to the scene. The detailed lines and varied postures add depth to the drawing.

artworks.title: The Bath [recto]
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting with a baby on her lap. The woman is reaching her hand into a large basin beside her. She has soft facial features, her head slightly turned down, and her hair neatly pulled back. She is wearing a long dress with a high collar and buttons. The baby is seated astride the woman's lap, facing forward and hugging the woman's waist, with minimal clothing on. The setting is plain, with an unadorned background providing no additional context.

artworks.title: The Bath [verso]
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated, holding a child in her lap. The woman's head is tilted downward, with her hair pulled back, and she wears a long-sleeved garment. One of her arms reaches towards a circular basin beside her. The child, shown from the back, is barefoot and looking down or towards the basin. The child's hair is short and curls around the head. The background is plain. The drawing is a simple line sketch emphasizing contours and form.

artworks.title: The Coiffure
artworks.medium: black crayon and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: Drawn with black crayon and silvery graphite on cream-colored paper, a woman, nude from the waist up, gathers her hair in her raised hands as she sits before a mirror in this vertical composition. The large mirror is to our left, and the woman’s body is mostly turned away from us, her head bowed. Her lower body is wrapped in a voluminous cloth as she leans forward on a chair. The mirror and room around the woman are loosely drawn with a few, economical lines. The artist signed the work in graphite under the lower right corner, “Mary Cassatt.” Another inscription below reads, “38 x 49.”

artworks.title: In the Omnibus [recto]
artworks.medium: black chalk and graphite on wove paper

artworks.title: In the Omnibus [verso]
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of three individuals. Two adults and a child are shown in a simple setting. The adult on the left wears a wide-brimmed hat and rests their arm on the backrest. The adult on the right leans towards the child. Both adults wear long dresses. The child is nestled between them. The background is plain with subtle lines indicating a wall and a bench.

artworks.title: The Cathedral of Florence (Le Dome florentin)
artworks.description: This image depicts a low angle view of two tall trees with extended branches and foliage. The background shows distant hills and a silhouetted structure with a dome. The artwork uses dynamic and scratchy lines in an etching style, creating depth through cross-hatching and varied strokes. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown and black on a cream background. Swirling lines represent a cloudy sky above additional trees and the silhouette of a building in the distance.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child Adored by Frederic the Wise of Saxony
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures: an adult woman, an infant, and an adult man. The woman is seated and looking downwards, wearing a headscarf with a floral design. She holds the infant, who has curly hair and is relaxed, grasping an object. The man, positioned to the right, wears richly textured garments with a fur collar and offers a gesture of prayer or respect. The background shows hills, trees, and buildings in a distant landscape through a window. Above is a depiction of clouds with an ornamental motif. A small decorative box is in the foreground, suggesting an indoor setting.

artworks.title: The Green Room
artworks.medium: monotype (black ink) on laid paper mounted by the artist on heavy white wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dimly lit interior scene with figures engaged in conversation. The image captures a softly focused setting where shadowy figures are gathered indoors under warm lighting. The drawing features a chandelier-like formation above the group. The figures are depicted with sketchy, loose lines, creating an impressionistic style that emphasizes mood over detail. In the foreground, a figure is seen seated. The overall atmosphere of the drawing gives a sense of an intimate gathering.

artworks.title: Foolish Virgin
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing with her left foot slightly forward, right hand holding a round object, and left hand resting on her hip. Her head is turned slightly downward, face partially obscured by her hair styled in intricate waves and curls, adorned with a ribbon or band trailing behind her. She wears a long, flowing dress with voluminous sleeves and a belt tied around her waist. She also wears a necklace and the dress has a decorated neckline. The background features a simple landscape with rolling hills and stylized clouds in the sky. At the lower left corner, text is inscribed on scroll-like shapes.

artworks.title: Foolish Virgin
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length portrait of a person standing in a slightly turned position with one arm extended forward while holding an object similar to a small lantern. The person's facial features are detailed with a sharp nose and focused gaze, and they have curly hair, partly covered by a headscarf. They are wearing elaborate, textured clothing that appears to be a dress with ornamental accents like tassels and a corset-like top, complemented by ribbons and laces. A piece of jewelry is wrapped around the person’s upper arm. The background features a detailed landscape with hills and what seems to be a castle among the clouds. A decorative dagger is also shown on the ground near their feet.

artworks.title: Death and the Lansquenet
artworks.medium: woodcut and letterpress text on two sheets of laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
block: 12.2 × 8.5 cm (4 13/16 × 3 3/8 in.)
sheet (with image and letterpress text): 20.8 × 15.1 cm (8 3/16 × 5 15/16 in.)
sheet (with only letterpress text): 20.3 × 15.1 cm (8 × 5 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a skeletal figure and a man with a halberd. The illustration features a skeletal figure holding an hourglass, interacting with an armored man carrying a halberd. The background includes a simple architectural element like a wall or a fence. The scene is enclosed within a rectangular frame on a page with text above and below the image. The style of the drawing resembles early 16th-century woodcuts. The text on the page is written in Gothic script.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross with Mary and Saint John
artworks.medium: woodcut and letterpress text on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene with accompanying text. The artwork features a central depiction of a crucifix, with the figure of Jesus Christ on the cross, flanked by two figures on either side. The illustration is complemented by columns of text in Gothic script below. The image is rendered in a detailed woodcut style, with intricate lines depicting the figures and foliage in the background.

artworks.title: Title Page for "Livre d'oiseaux"
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of a decorative book dedication featuring cherubs and a coat of arms. Two winged cherubs hold up a draped cloth that frames an inscription dedicating the book to a notable figure. The bottom center of the composition includes an ornate heraldic emblem with a shield, lions, and a decorative crest. The border of the cloth has ornate swirls and floral motifs, enhancing the dedication's presentation. The illustration uses detailed line work typical of engravings, giving it an elegant and classical appearance.

artworks.title: Vanellus, The Lapwing
artworks.description: The image depicts a serene natural scene from a slightly elevated point of view, showcasing a detailed landscape filled with dynamic bird life. The horizon is marked by a line of trees, creating a dense boundary beyond which the sky emerges. The trees are rendered with intricate brushstrokes, capturing their foliage and adding texture to the landscape. The color palette is limited to black and white, emphasizing the forms and actions of the birds. Closest to us, a group of birds is gathered, with some taking flight and others resting or foraging near water. In the distance, more birds are in flight, enhancing the sense of depth and continuity in the scene.

artworks.title: Querpedula, The Teal
artworks.description: The image shows a slightly elevated point of view overlooking water, birds, and landscape. The horizon is visible with trees and a distant building. Birds, including one with outstretched wings, are in the foreground. Detailed cross-hatching is used for the birds. Rushes, a small building, and trees are seen near the water. Birds are scattered across the sky, adding dynamism. The color palette is monochromatic with dark ink against a light background.

artworks.title: Pedrix rubra, The Red-Legged Partridge
artworks.description: The image displays a natural landscape with a group of birds. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing a detailed depiction of the birds, trees, and sky. The style features detailed line work typical of etching, creating a textured appearance. A group of red-legged partridges is seen on the ground amidst grass and plants. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and white.

artworks.title: Ficedula, The Bullfinch
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a gnarled tree branch, birds perched on it, one bird in flight. In the distance, there is foliage, a distant structure, likely a church or tower, against the sky. The style is etching with fine detail. The color palette is monochrome with various shades of black and off-white. The sky is light with minimal cloud cover, highlighting the detailed foreground.

artworks.title: Rusticula, The Woodcock
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a rustic setting. The composition shows trees, thatched-roof structures, and detailed leaves. The artwork is monochrome with delicate line work. Birds are depicted with detailed feathers, some on the ground and others in flight. Vegetation, a winding path, and a horizon with trees can be seen in the distance, creating a sense of depth.

artworks.title: Rusticula minor, The Snipe
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed scene viewed at eye level. The horizon line is higher with distant trees creating a boundary. In the distance to the left, there is a small house with a thatched roof emitting smoke. The artwork is done in an etching style with intricate lines defining forms and textures for depth. The palette is monochrome, using shades of black and white to emphasize texture and form. Ducks float on water in the foreground, surrounded by vegetation. A few birds are flying above the water to the right. The image has a classic appearance reminiscent of traditional landscape studies.

artworks.title: Ortygometra, The Rail
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two birds in a natural setting. The drawing depicts a pastoral scene with two birds on the ground at the foreground, surrounded by grasses and a pond edge, while a third bird is seen flying in the sky above. The birds are detailed with carefully hatched lines to show their texture, with one bird bending forward to peck the ground. In the background, there is a lush landscape with trees and clear sky, where the detailed foliage is represented with intricate line work. The perspective of the drawing creates depth and highlights the serenity of the natural environment. The composition shows a harmonious balance between the wildlife and their habitat.

artworks.title: Carduelis, The Goldfinch
artworks.description: The image displays birds perched and flying around dense foliage, with a low horizon featuring trees and a sky with cloud-like lines. The style is etching with fine lines detailing plants and birds. The color palette is monochromatic, using black ink on a light background.
